name: A Fairy Tale
source:
Pride and Prejudice with fairies... and a little light murder.

A Fairy Tale is a 28,000 word visual novel about fairies finding love.

Play as the sole heir to a noble (but somewhat underfunded) fairy estate. You have one night to find a marriage which will secure your family's future... or lead everything to ruin.

Who—if anyone—will win your hand?

[from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230901084455/https://barbara-truelove.itch.io/a-fairy-tale]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
傲慢与偏见与仙女……还有一点轻微的谋杀。

《童话》是一部28,000字的视觉小说，讲述仙女寻找爱情的故事。

扮演贵族（但资金有些不足）童话庄园的唯一继承人。你有一晚的时间来寻找一场婚姻，它可以保障你家庭的未来……或者导致一切毁灭。

谁（如果有的话）会赢得你的青睐？

[来自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230901084455/https://barbara-truelove.itch.io/a-fairy-tale]Itch.io[/url]]
